note: What was read by eye, 2026-11-21, for the scene of Bahnhofplatz. 'markings' are digitised from the aerial photo: Orthofoto 2026 of the City of Bern (WMS Geoportal/Orthofoto_2026, flown March/April 2026; the 10 cm crop showcase/imagery/bahnhofplatz-heiliggeist/aerial_bern2026_bahnhofplatz-heiliggeist_raw.png, which ends at model y -45.3, and the 25 cm overview showcase/data/stadt_bern/ortho2026/overview_25cm_*.jpg north of that), with a 5 m model grid drawn on it (scripts/crop_model.py in the research folder). Positions are good to about 0.4 m on the 10 cm photo and 0.8 m on the 25 cm one. Not done for this scene (no time): which groups of LiDAR returns are lamps and tram masts ('lidar_objects' is empty, so the scene has no lamps and no masts), storeys and fronts of the houses, the lane lines and the BUS lettering on the roadways.

markings.seen: Orthofoto 2026 Stadt Bern, digitised by eye: the wide yellow pedestrian crossing from the square to the pavement in front of the station, which the walk uses; about 12 bars of 13 to 14 m. The south half (to y -45) is read on the 10 cm photo (corners to about 0.4 m), the north half on the 25 cm overview (about 0.8 m). The painted area is a five-sided shape: its south edge bends at (78.0, -56.0); the ring here is the four-sided shape inside it (up to 1 m of paint at that bend is left out)

Orthofoto 2026 Stadt Bern (the 10 m grid picture aerial_bern2026_bahnhofplatz-heiliggeist_grid.png), digitised by eye (corners to about 1 m): yellow pedestrian crossing west of the Baldachin, between the square and the pavement at the Burgerspital; about 11 bars, each about 10 m long, lying north-south

Orthofoto 2026 Stadt Bern (10 cm), digitised by eye: a pair of thin white lines about 0.5 m apart that runs from the south-east corner of the crossing at (80.3, -57.4) straight to the north end of the Baldachin; probably the guide line for blind people. Drawn as one white band of that width
Orthofoto 2026 Stadt Bern (10 cm), digitised by eye: the same pair of white lines turns west at (84.9, -71.6) and ends in a white square at about (78.6, -71.4)
Orthofoto 2026 Stadt Bern (10 cm), digitised by eye: yellow bicycle symbol on the cycle lane west of the square, with a yellow arrow north of it
Orthofoto 2026 Stadt Bern (10 cm), digitised by eye: yellow arrow north of the bicycle symbol at (78.3, -64.7); it bends to the left at its tip, drawn straight
